proof:
Source: step 3 of the parent proof. It is stated here for an arbitrary set W: openness of W is not used, because the argument compares with μ_R(tsupport ω).
Notation: M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult, ξ = R.orient, ν := Hⁿ⌞M, μ := R.measure = ν.withDensity θ ≪ ν, |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm.
1. (A.e. duality bound.) Choose L by the sibling theorem dor_ims_unitOrientation_dual (unit_orientation_duality). Only its part (a) is used: if IsUnitOrientationOf ξ₀ Q, then |ξ₀(α)| ≤ |α| for all α. By R.orients, for ν-a.e. x there is Q with IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ(x)) Q. Hence for ν-a.e. x, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all α. Since μ ≪ ν (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous, AbsolutelyContinuous.ae_le), this holds for μ-a.e. x.
2. (Reduction.) T.massOn W is the supremum of ofReal(T(ω)) over ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn U n W. By sSup_le it suffices to show ofReal(T(ω)) ≤ μ(W) for every admissible ω.
3. Fix an admissible ω and put K := tsupport ω. K is compact, K ⊆ U (ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U)) and K ⊆ W (admissibility). K is closed, hence measurable, so by withDensity_apply and restrict_restrict, μ(K) = ∫_{M∩K} θ dHⁿ < ∞ (R.locallyIntegrable_mult).
4. By R.Represents T and the sibling theorem dor_ims_action_eq_integral (action_integral_formula), T(ω) = R.action ω = ∫ f dμ, where f(x) := ξ(x)(ω(x)) is μ-integrable.
5. (Pointwise comparison.) For μ-a.e. x:
 - if x ∈ K, then f(x) ≤ |f(x)| ≤ |ω(x)| ≤ 1, by step 1 and admissibility;
 - if x ∉ K, then ω(x) = 0 (image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport), so f(x) = 0.
 So f ≤ 1_K μ-a.e., and 1_K is μ-integrable because μ(K) < ∞. By monotonicity of the integral (integral_mono_ae, integral_indicator_one), T(ω) = ∫ f dμ ≤ ∫ 1_K dμ = μ(K).toReal.
6. Hence ofReal(T(ω)) ≤ ofReal(μ(K).toReal) = μ(K) ≤ μ(W). The equality uses μ(K) < ∞; the inequality uses K ⊆ W and monotonicity of μ, valid for any W. Taking the supremum over admissible ω gives M_W(T) ≤ μ(W). (Machine-checked from the sibling types: /tmp/imrep-ms-decomp/Sanity.lean.)
